hypothesis: Immediate sleeping of idle LLVM OpenMP workers may reduce CPU contention or shared power pressure during GPU-heavy MTP generation
source_gate: The installed CPU backend uses GGML_USE_OPENMP; ggml's custom --poll busywait loop is excluded from that build. Test the active OpenMP runtime instead.
candidate_change: Set only child-process KMP_BLOCKTIME=0; control leaves KMP_BLOCKTIME unset
engagement: Use KMP_SETTINGS=1 in both arms to record the effective blocktime at process startup. Stop before a model run if the default is already zero or engagement cannot be verified.
stop_rule: One default-versus-zero comparison. No wait-policy or intermediate-blocktime sweep. Deployment requires subsequent quality and repeated release-stack confirmation.
